summary: Well-structured functional test suite that appropriately exercises the aggregator through the GitHub Actions pipeline (per project policy). Tests cover all major requirements: JUnit/JSON parsing, multi-run aggregation, flaky detection, error handling, and markdown generation. Three test files provide lint validation, workflow structure verification, and end-to-end pipeline testing with exact output assertions. Strengths: clear scenario coverage (5 scenarios: basic aggregation, empty results, malformed XML, invalid JSON, unsupported extension), exact output validation (totals, per-run breakdown, flaky tests identified by name), efficient execution (single act run with subsequent assertions). Gaps: fixture files referenced but not shown in prompt; no direct unit tests of library functions (by design per stated policy, but limits debugging); limited edge case exploration beyond explicit error scenarios (character escaping, duration precision, multiline messages, missing attributes); tests are brittle to output format changes due to tight grep patterns. The test suite would catch major regressions but may miss subtle bugs in edge cases.
